scores.tell: Saturated blue background and neon lens colors are fine; slightly cool, low warm share, but hero navy is muted like real cards.
Large grey moon surface and purple sky make a muted, cool palette with little saturated hero; the real cards are louder and cleaner.
none; orange hero on green stripes with navy hands and one red accent matches the real flat-color style.
Golden rope on purple with a red accent is a good complementary pairing; the pale purple wave pattern is a bit soft.
Fruit is natural, but the orange and yellow wood and stripe background pull everything warm. Many hue families, so the hero doesn't separate from the background.
Teal water fills most of the card at similar chroma all over, with no neutral rest. The scene feels like an environment illustration rather than an icon palette.
Green hero on an orange sunburst is a clear complementary split. Greys and a yellow stripe are slightly muddy, and the track is a dull blue-grey.
Too many hue families (green, red, blue, orange, yellow, brown) all at full chroma, so nothing rests the eye. The real cards use one or two.
Magenta wall with cream column and orange base is a dark, heavy palette. Shadows are muddy purple and the whole card is dim compared with the bright real cards.
Red-orange pump on an orange desert and purple sunset sky gives a warm-heavy scene. The hero blends into the background, and the shadows are orange-red.
